title: Degraded Availability for MAI Code 2 in Copilot
summary: This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available.

timeline.body: We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Copilot AI Model Providers
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We are experiencing degraded availability for the MAI Code 2 model in Copilot products and IDE surfaces. This is due to an issue with an upstream model provider. While we work with them to resolve the issue, we recommend choosing another model or selecting ‘Copilot Fusion’ to continue using Copilot.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We have been working with the upstream provider and applying mitigations, and are seeing improvement in availability for MAI Code 2 across Copilot products and IDE surfaces. We will continue monitoring.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The degradation affecting Copilot AI Model Providers has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
timeline.label: monitoring

timeline.body: The issues with our upstream model provider have been resolved, and MAI Code 2 is once again available in Copilot products and IDE surfaces. We will continue monitoring to ensure stability, but mitigation is complete.
timeline.label: monitoring

timeline.body: This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available.
timeline.label: resolved
